description_en: Configures multiple accelerated domain names in a batch by calling BatchSetCdnDomainConfig
description_zh: 调用BatchSetCdnDomainConfig进行域名批量配置
name: BatchSetCdnDomainConfig

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following configuration limits:
The product of the number of domain names and the number of features specified by Functions must be less than or equal to 20. For example:
If the number of features specified by Functions is 20, you can specify only one domain name at a time.
If the number of features specified by Functions is 1, you can specify up to 20 domain names at a time
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，注意以下配置限制：
“域名数量” 乘以 “Functions 数量” 的值小于等于 20。例如：
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为20，那么单次只能传1个域名。
如果单次配置的Functions 数量为1，那么单次可以传20个域名
parameters.name: domain_names
